# ruststream-kinesis

> `ruststream-kinesis` is the Amazon Kinesis Data Streams broker crate for RustStream, a Rust framework for services that subscribe to message brokers and publish to them. It runs over the official `aws-sdk-kinesis` client: a subscription discovers the stream's shards across splits and merges, leases each shard with fencing and checkpoints its progress, so an acknowledgement is a checkpoint and delivery is at-least-once.

A subscription is the descriptor `KinesisStream`, which names the stream and carries the pause between reads. A routes file imports `ruststream_kinesis::prelude::*`, which offers `KinesisPublish` as `Publish`; a body that sets the partition key of one record takes the `partition_key` step from `KinesisPublishSteps`. The `dynamodb-lease` feature adds `DynamoLeaseStore`, so several service instances share the shards.

This site holds the entry pages. The crate's guide is its overview on docs.rs, and the framework itself is documented on the RustStream site.

## Site

- [Home](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/): what the crate does, its cargo features and a first service
- [Benchmarks](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/benchmarks/): what this crate and the framework's runtime cost over the raw `aws-sdk-kinesis` client on LocalStack, and how to re-measure it with `just bench`

## Guide

- [Overview](https://docs.rs/ruststream-kinesis/latest/ruststream_kinesis/index.html): the transport and a first service
- [Subscribing](https://docs.rs/ruststream-kinesis/latest/ruststream_kinesis/index.html#subscribing): the stream descriptor, settling a record and delayed redelivery with its cap
- [Leases and checkpoints](https://docs.rs/ruststream-kinesis/latest/ruststream_kinesis/index.html#leases-and-checkpoints): how shards are leased and progress is checkpointed per stream and shard, in one process or across instances, and how a lease table an earlier version wrote is upgraded
- [Batches](https://docs.rs/ruststream-kinesis/latest/ruststream_kinesis/index.html#batches): batch handlers over a shard's records
- [Positions and seeking](https://docs.rs/ruststream-kinesis/latest/ruststream_kinesis/index.html#positions-and-seeking): where a subscription starts and how a handler repositions it
- [Publishing](https://docs.rs/ruststream-kinesis/latest/ruststream_kinesis/index.html#publishing): the publish policy, the partition key, replies and the header envelope
- [The prelude](https://docs.rs/ruststream-kinesis/latest/ruststream_kinesis/index.html#the-prelude): what a routes file and a handler body import
- [The generated document](https://docs.rs/ruststream-kinesis/latest/ruststream_kinesis/index.html#the-generated-document): what the `asyncapi` feature reports
- [Testing](https://docs.rs/ruststream-kinesis/latest/ruststream_kinesis/index.html#testing): the production app under `TestApp`, `KinesisBroker` in process behind the `testing` feature or against a live stream
- [Operations](https://docs.rs/ruststream-kinesis/latest/ruststream_kinesis/index.html#operations): credentials, a local stack, read budgets and the client's limits
- [Cargo features](https://docs.rs/ruststream-kinesis/latest/ruststream_kinesis/index.html#cargo-features): `asyncapi`, `dynamodb-lease` and `testing`
